about: What fighting skill and the attributes do in a fight (Docs/Design/49-characters-and-earned-gifts.md, the balance pass). Each slope is so much per point from 50, so a plain new wolf fights the same whatever they are. Simulated with Tests/level_sim.cpp (suite growth; SIM_FIGHT tries other wolf slopes). Checked by tools/progression_catalog.py.

hit.about: A blow's odds: base + (DEX − foe's DEX) × hitPerDex + (skill − foe's skill) × hitPerSkill, plus the angle, held between least and most. A blow to or from an animal is on the animals' slopes.

initiative.about: The turn meter a tick: base + initiativePerDex × (DEX − 50) + perArmour × armour's weight (in DEX points, 0 or less: doc 35).

move.about: Tiles a turn at a trot, unhurt: base + movePerDex × (DEX − 50).

breath.about: Stamina back each turn: base + perStr × (STR − 50), plus the stamina attribute's own (creation.json, stamina.turnPer).

shove.about: A shove's odds per point of STR over the foe's.

wolves.about: Players and residents: growing by practice should show, not decide (the user, 2026-10-10). Bare and plain against a new wolf: a veteran's skill wins about 60%, a grown STR or DEX (70) 56-58%, all of it grown about 79%.

animals.about: Game and wild beasts keep the slopes their stats were made for (Data/Wild/animals.json: STR 3 to 85; docs 41 and 53).
